openingPressures.title: Containment Anchor Cascade
openingPressures.summary: The strike destabilizes several Council Crown containment anchors, forcing immediate choices about evacuation, repair, and who receives protection first.

openingPressures.title: Creature Incursion
openingPressures.summary: Tear-born creatures enter the confused evacuation routes after the strike, dividing attention between rescue, defense, and preventing their movement deeper into the Crown.

openingPressures.title: Council Crown Fracture
openingPressures.summary: Raw Tear-magic fractures part of the Council Crown, trapping separated groups and damaging routes needed by officials, guards, and civilians.

openingPressures.title: Missing Emergency Dispatch
openingPressures.summary: A critical sealed dispatch vanishes during the attack, leaving conflicting emergency orders and uncertainty over whether the loss was accidental or deliberate.

openingPressures.title: Alteration Wave
openingPressures.summary: A wave of unstable magic alters people within the plaza at different intensities, creating an immediate medical crisis and fear of further change.

openingPressures.title: Unequal Emergency Seal
openingPressures.summary: Emergency wards seal the plaza unevenly, protecting some sections while trapping others and cutting off the most direct routes to safety and command.

factionPressures.summary: The factions disagree over who may direct an emergency when central authority is incapacitated.
The factions compete over where scarce people, supplies, knowledge, and equipment should be committed first.
The factions disagree over what the public should be told and what knowledge is too dangerous or destabilizing to release.
The factions support incompatible methods for stabilizing the Tear and the city's containment system.
The factions disagree over whether civilian continuity, institutional survival, research, or defense must receive priority.
The factions contest who may recover, study, secure, distribute, or conceal dangerous material arriving from the Tear.

clueRoutes.summary: Conflicting but individually credible witness accounts reveal that the event was experienced differently from separate positions.
Persistent residue, damage, or material traces allow the event to be investigated through physical evidence.
Containment readings and maintenance history preserve a technical route into the mystery.
Missing, altered, stolen, or restricted records create an intelligence route into the mystery.
Symptoms and changes in affected life preserve a medical and biological route into the mystery.
An object displaced or changed by the Tear carries evidence that can be interpreted in more than one way.

reversals.summary: Evidence believed to explain one event is discovered to combine traces from two separate causes.
A person protected as a victim or witness is found to have concealed a separate motive without necessarily causing the original disaster.
A successful local solution is revealed to have displaced pressure elsewhere in Velmora instead of removing it.
A useful discovery remains genuinely valuable but carries a cost that changes who is willing to use it.
